reviewer.actualMethod: Actual additional direct technical bilingual review of all 27 exact Source11 English/native/parameter/owner/context pairs against read-only source implementations and frozen plan clauses. evidenceInput.nativeRevisionScope: Exact 27 native values in this input, each identical to the original Source10 sample; not a hash claim for a currently changing full catalog.

authority.interpretation: Keep queues canonical and map stable operation/owner references to localized display templates. Generated message identity includes operation kind/stable occurrence; identical English in distinct contexts need not be one translation unit. Consequently an exchange-shared English verb is not authoritative over an explicit physical send/receive role. This permits native per-binding actor perspective without rewriting canonical technical data.

decision.rationale: The original unresolved English-action/context difference is resolved by actual source evidence and the display-localization contract. Every native message matches the explicit current operation/actor while preserving protected data, negation, prior provenance and credential boundaries. No native rewrite, queue/model repair or owner waiver is needed for these 27 exact bindings.
decision.FASTSpecificDecision: The existing Hebrew relative clause identifies prior FAST issuance of the received ticket; it does not label its current TGS-request carrier a FAST response. Current wslDC receive versus borrowed earlier create prose is supported by source cloning of the same accepted opaque TGT.
